children: China's urban unemployment rate for youths was at 18% in September, improving from August's 18.9% which had been the worst reading in 12 months, data released by the National Bureau of Statistics showed on Wednesday.
The group consists of 16- to 24-year-olds, excluding students.
For people aged 25 to 29, the unemployment rate was 7.4%, down from 7.5% in August. The rate for 30- to-59-year-olds matched the August rate, at 3.9%.
